cases.name: bound/no-product/anonymous analysis APIs run with unchanged engine input
same images different binding conflict without extra credits; replay fixed snapshot
simultaneous same-key API calls reserve once by source and settle only after completion
race after credit reserve releases exactly once and never calls provider
missing R2 binary fails original task; releases reservation; no fallback reference
disabled API explicitly rejects new profile/binding; history remains available
API foreign identifiers return 404 and no revision/content
expired reference before binding and after archive/restore cannot be reused
real batch worker copies saved snapshot, repeated delivery does not call provider twice
report/workspace deletion cascades snapshots without changing retention

limitations: Real local D1; remote production and replica behavior not verified.

Authentication, credits, queue, public guards and provider are controlled synthetic stubs; application routes, repositories, analysis service, batch worker and QA engine/policy run unchanged against real local D1.
Browser UI interaction is recorded separately; no real credentials, images, models, payments or cloud resources used.
